input.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to AP's affiliates on written notice and make it transferable to an M&A successor.
input.comment: [Playbook] The grant runs to AP alone and is expressly non-transferable and non-assignable, so our affiliates have no path to use the Auction Platform and the licence would not follow AP into a merger or sale. We have extended the grant to affiliates upon written notice to Kubient and made it transferable to an M&A successor, which is our fallback position.

ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer and, upon written notice to Kubient, its affiliates a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, without right of sublicense, revocable license, transferable to Customer's successor in a merger or acquisition without Kubient's approval, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand
